svg.aria-label: Topology: two dusts below dimension one are the same set; gasket and dust differ at dimension 1.585
svg.title: Topology: two dusts below dimension one are the same set; gasket and dust differ at dimension 1.585

g.text: The topology dial is silent below dimension 1 and speaks once pieces touch
Below 1: B and C look different...
...but every dust with no isolated points is the
same Cantor set up to stretching (Brouwer, 1910).
So shape below 1 is geometry, not topology.
At dimension log 3 / log 2 ≈ 1.585: same number, different topology
pieces share corners at every level
